body.title: Re-point artifact.feedback.append at the service
body.summary: Make the daemon's artifact.feedback.append handler convert its legacy request (coerceRequest in src/workflow/artifacts/provenance/tool.ts) into FeedbackService.add: kind feedback becomes revision-request, suggestion and comment stay; the anchor maps quote, sectionSlug (as section), prefix and suffix; a target.file other than the artifact's own document goes into anchor.section; the author string becomes the actor name when no actor id is given; the result keeps its shape with the stored entry's id. The legacy appendFeedback writer stays for callers outside the daemon.
acceptanceChecks: a legacy request stores a Feedback line with the mapped kind and anchor and returns its id
a companion-file target is kept on the parent artifact with the file path in anchor.section
the request shape and the error shape of the handler are unchanged for existing clients
the legacy appendFeedback writer still works for callers outside the daemon and its tests pass

tests.name: feedback-wiring.test.ts: the daemon's artifact.feedback.append handler stores a legacy request as a Feedback line with the mapped kind and anchor, keeps a companion-file target in anchor.section, and keeps its request and error shapes
